install_startup.recipe_modification_note: The project's own compose file pulls ghcr.io/gitroomhq/postiz-app, with no Docker Hub equivalent (gitroomhq isn't on Docker Hub at all) - but the repo ships Dockerfile.dev, a real production build (pnpm install, pnpm build, nginx+pm2 to serve), just named for local dev compose. Built from it directly instead (Dockerfile.library), which needed several fixes: (1) Dockerfile.dev's apt-get for g++/make/python3-pip/nginx needs deb.debian.org, also blocked - switched the base image to the non-slim node:22.20-bookworm (already ships g++/make/python3) and got nginx by copying its binary + libs from the official nginx:stable-bookworm Docker Hub image (matched to the same Debian bookworm base for glibc compatibility), plus the standard nginx cache/temp directories nginx's own apt package would have created. (2) the sandbox's proxy CA needed adding for pnpm install (NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS). (3) next build fetches next/font/google files at build time, not just runtime - needed HTTPS_PROXY/HTTP_PROXY build args plus network: host on the build so the sandbox's egress proxy (on the host's 127.0.0.1) was reachable from inside the build container. (4) the backend hard-requires Temporal at startup (gRPC to TEMPORAL_ADDRESS, not optional despite only being network-joined in the original compose) - added trimmed temporal + temporal-postgresql + temporal-elasticsearch services (all official Docker Hub images already used by the project's own compose file); SQL-only visibility (ENABLE_ES=false) failed registering the app's custom search attributes ('cannot have more than 3 search attribute of type Text'), so kept Elasticsearch as the project's own compose does. (5) the frontend calls its backend at the literal hostname in NEXT_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL/MAIN_URL (localhost) - reached via 127.0.0.1 in the browser, the same-origin check failed as a cross-origin CORS request with no Access-Control-Allow-Origin; using http://localhost:4007/ (matching the configured URLs) instead of 127.0.0.1 resolved it, no image change needed. Dropped the admin-panel-equivalent (spotlight, temporal-ui, temporal-admin-tools) as debug/ops tooling, not core functionality.
install_startup.startup_command: docker compose -f docker-compose.library.yml build postiz && docker compose -f docker-compose.library.yml up -d
